card.name: Verbs after 'have been' reporting events
card.fires_on: The word that follows a phrase like 'have been', 'have', or 'previous infusion' and reports whether an effect was seen or occurred. It is typically a past participle such as seen or occurred, or a noun such as response or experience, in label safety text.

modes.label: Reported event verbs
modes.description: A participle after 'have' or 'have been' saying an adverse effect was seen or occurred.
modes.example: Infusion site reactions have<< occurred>> with the use of esmol

modes.label: After previous infusion
modes.description: A word after a mention of the previous dose or infusion, in dosing instructions.
modes.example: If an infusion-related reaction occurred during the previous<< infusion>>, administer at 50 mg/hr
